itemized.notes: Charles A. Bonsall, Salt Lake County Clerk (Libertarian), '2006 Financial Disclosure Report', signed 1/22/07, clerk-stamped JAN 23 2007. TWO report-type boxes are checked: the January-31 YEAR-END box AND the FINAL REPORT box (consistent with index.csv's 'January 31 of each year + Final Report'). Both schedules are BLANK - empty grids with a printed 0.00 in each subtotal and total - so this final report closes a campaign with no activity in the period. Column B (Sum Total to Date) does carry activity: 1,543.11 raised and 962.91 spent across the whole campaign, but Column A (this period) is zero on both sides and no itemized line exists anywhere in the document. Summary Page lines 3-7 Column A are all slashed-zero glyphs. The cover's address/phone/email fields were left EMPTY by the filer (not redacted).
